context: Asuka lectures on how language changes.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; formal vocabulary (自体/とともに/以来/以降/いずれ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 言葉は、時代とともに変わります。
lines.en: Language changes along with the times.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 言葉自体の意味も、変わるんですか?
lines.en: Does the meaning of the word itself change too?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、近代以降、大きく変わりました。
lines.en: Yes, since the modern era it changed greatly.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いつ以来、研究されているんですか?
lines.en: Since when has it been studied?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 百年以来、熱心に研究されています。
lines.en: It's been keenly studied for a century.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いずれ、もっと変わるんでしょうか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いずれ、新しい言葉も生まれるでしょう。
lines.en: Eventually, new words will be born too.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 言葉自体が、生きているんですね。
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
